description: AgentNotify harness example for Codex. Copy the three event blocks into your real hooks file (~/.codex/hooks.json for you, or <repo>/.codex/hooks.json for a project) and replace HOOK_DIR with the folder holding agentnotify_hook.py. Prefer `agentnotify install-harness codex` so the merge, absolute paths, and idempotency are handled for you. The hook only notifies; it never approves or denies — exit 0 always, 10 s timeout.
